considerations.reason: The text's unclear phrasing is clarified in the rewrite as 'which reflects apical-basal regulation'. This makes an unclear statement scientifically correct, which is allowed.

considerations.reason: The text points to a slide showing abnormal tissue. The rewrite's description 'In the image of the invasive tissue' turns this pointing phrase into a description that is scientifically correct based on the context of the cells having invaded the stroma.
The phrase 'come in' carries the same meaning in this context as 'invaded' or 'moved over', so its omission is allowed as using different words with exactly the same meaning.
The phrase in the text is likely a transcriber error. The rewrite's 'signalling basis' correctly replaces the wrong words and is scientifically correct.
The text mistakenly says 'invading stroma' when the stroma is actually being invaded by the cells. The rewrite corrects this to 'invaded stroma', which is scientifically correct and allowed.
